name: Taru Mitsuka
source:
Taru is possibly most unlucky fellow in history, but somehow is completely oblivious to it. Living his life in a happy-go-lucky manner, Taru manages to spin any troublesome situation in his mind with a silver lining. Taru is from a very prosperous family, and tends to live a very flamboyant life, not worrying that his luck will cause trouble for his well-planned future. However, he wasn't always that unlucky! Is his oblivious outlook a facade?
